scripts.assistant:install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Test-Path ./dist/AG3NT-Assistant-Setup.exe)) { Write-Host 'Setup EXE not found. Run pnpm run build:assistant:setup first.'; exit 1 }; ./dist/AG3NT-Assistant-Setup.exe"
scripts.assistant:uninstall: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Test-Path ./dist/AG3NT-Assistant-Setup.exe)) { Write-Host 'Setup EXE not found. Run pnpm run build:assistant:setup first.'; exit 1 }; ./dist/AG3NT-Assistant-Setup.exe --silent --uninstall"
